title: Schwinger effect with backreaction in 1+1D massive QED with a strong external field
read_depth: Initially read v1; then verified latest v2 introduction, sections V-VI (Eqs. 92-117) and Appendix B (especially Eqs. 140-148). Not a replication of the entire paper.
claim: A controlled first-order-in-mass bosonized comparator can differ from semiclassical backreaction; compact-momentum nonuniform-expansion issue independently audited.
limitation: The 1+1-dimensional first-order mass result is not automatically a matched 3+1-dimensional multi-Landau-level theory.

title: Linear Response Analysis of the Semiclassical Approximation to Spin 1/2 Quantum Electrodynamics in 1+1 Dimensions
authors: Ian M. Newsome; Paul R. Anderson; Eric M. Grotzke
read_depth: Full-text sections IV-V, retarded-current equations 22-35 and numerical cases; abstract and revision metadata.
claim: A semiclassical solution needs a fluctuation/retarded-response validity check; vacuum current correlations persist before particles.
limitation: Specific 1+1-dimensional sources and mass/field ratios, not universal failure of mean-field QED.
